title: UPSSSC PET 2022 Certificate
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
postName: Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) 2022 – Score Card / Certificate
documentsRequired: Application number, roll number, DOB, registered email/mobile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Open PET 2022 score card / certificate link
3. Login with registration number and DOB
4. Download PET score certificate
5. Use score for eligible UPSSSC recruitments within validity
shortDescription: UPSSSC PET 2022 Certificate / score card download from upsssc.gov.in for eligibility in commission exams.
content:
UPSSSC PET 2022 score is used as eligibility for various subordinate service recruitments.

Candidates can download the PET score card / certificate from upsssc.gov.in. Check validity period mentioned in recruitment advertisements before applying.
